items.raw_excerpt: The new measures move us toward treating child-raising as something to build and maintain collectively as a society, says Kalpana Vignehsa from the Institute of Policy Studies.

An expert from the Institute of Policy Studies says the real change goes beyond the S$70,000 baby bonus per child. items.raw_excerpt: La France compte plus de 35 000 communes, dont une majorité de petites localités rurales. Parmi elles, certaines se distinguent par une population quasi inexistante.

items.raw_excerpt: Not everything in Switzerland is getting more expensive: the annual radio and television fee is set to become cheaper.
items.summary_en: Switzerland's radio and television license fee will decrease starting in 2027. Most prices in Switzerland have been rising, but the mandatory TV fee is going the other way. The government decided to make the fee cheaper for all households.

items.raw_excerpt: Ambassador Bridge owner Matthew Moroun sought a meeting with senior Canadian officials as the bridge's nearly century-old monopoly on commercial traffic between Windsor and Detroit faced a new competitor. Government records reveal why Ottawa agreed to listen, but much of what Moroun wanted remains secret.
items.summary_en: The owner of the Ambassador Bridge between Canada and the US met senior Canadian officials before the new Gordie Howe Bridge opened. The new bridge would end the Ambassador Bridge's near-century monopoly on commercial traffic between Windsor and Detroit. Documents show why the government agreed to meet, but much of what was discussed remains secret.
